title: VovaKiller
wikitext:
Started in 3D-action with DOOM - so I'm an old-school fighter. Got into the clan "through connections" - a friend of AlexRed's, studied in the same school class. :)

I like beer, beer, beer, ..., when there is no beer - vodka. I also like Quake, women with big breasts, Mylene Farmer (although her breasts are not very good), the song "Fire" by Scooter, fishing, TeamFortress. And beer - I almost forgot! ;)

By an immodest estimate - the best sniper-modemist in Russian TF.

Nasty character. But that's when sober. :)
